column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/poison_boundary.onsa tests=6 evaluated=6 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ boom adds a counter to the truncated input
@ a NaN input panics in process and fails the test
@ an input outside I32 panics in process and fails the test
@ init_boom adds 100 / n to the input
render poison_boundary.init_boom sr=0x41000000 cfg n=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ a panic in init fails the test
@ a panic in process through an explicit state fails the test
